龙国篇龙国篇第十九章龙心塔（二）
“通了，终于通了！”
叶恒猛地站起，眼中闪烁着激动的光芒，他紧盯着艾米手中的地图，指尖在其上迅速勾勒出一条条路线，“我锁定了龙气的源头，它如同细丝般不绝如缕地从一个特定的点喷薄而出，而那个点，龙气汇聚之密集，是龙心塔无疑。”
叶恒：“我们如今的地势，真是让人头疼，明明身处于城中心，看似离龙心塔只有咫尺之遥，但实际上，这地势的险峻与龙气的干扰，每一次努力向前，都仿佛被某种无形的力量牵引着，回到了原点，就好似我们从一开始踏入神龙市时，就已经步入了一个神秘的阵法之中。”
说到这里，叶恒深吸一口气，缓缓抬起右手，掌心之上，一抹璀璨的光芒悄然浮现，那是他独有的光属性武神力“但是，不必灰心，我的光属性武神力，将是我们冲破这迷阵的关键，它将指引我们，找到正确的道路，带领我们走向龙心塔。”
艾露不由得歪了歪嘴，脸上露出一丝怀疑的神色：“这……靠谱吗？”
艾米见状，瞪了瞪了艾露一眼，语气中带着几分不满：“你少说些废话行不行？现在都什么时候了，你还这么多疑？阿恒虽是B级武神，但他的判断和能力，则是你们这些叛徒比不了的？”
“好了好了，艾米姐您就消消气，消消气，不要和她一般辩论”
一边说着一边阻止着艾露。
两人的嬉笑调情，如同一幅温馨而又略带俏皮的画卷，悄然触动了叶恒的心弦，令他不由自主地陷入了深深的思索之中。
“倘若世间无战事，该是何等美好。”
然而，现实的棱角锋利如刀，战争的阴霾如同一张无形的巨网，悄然笼罩在这片土地上，它无声无息，却锋利至极，深深割裂着每个人的心灵，留下一道道难以愈合的伤痕。
叶恒的目光黯淡下来，心中涌动着无尽的感慨。
他深知，在这动荡不安的岁月里，每一刻的安宁与欢笑都是那么弥足珍贵，如同沙漠中的清泉，令人渴望而又难以触及。
这份美好，似乎近在咫尺，却又遥不可及，如同梦幻泡影，一触即碎。
他默默地凝视着眼前的一切，心中五味杂陈，战争的残酷，让他更加珍惜眼前这片刻的宁静，即便它脆弱得如同风中残烛，随时可能熄灭，但正是这份珍贵与不易，让叶恒更加坚定了内心的信念——为了守护这份难得的安宁，他愿意付出一切努力，去追寻那个遥远而美好的和平世界，他相信，只要人们心中有爱，有对和平的渴望，那么总有一天，战争就会远去，和平将会降临，他期待着那一天的到来，期待着在未来能够再次看到她们三姐妹无忧无虑地嬉戏打闹就像12年前一样，期待着整个世界都风调雨顺，这不仅仅是叶恒一个人的梦想，更是所有武神和所有人的梦想。
衣裳丰盈，粮食满仓；国家昌盛，百姓安宁；灯火阑珊，合家欢乐，让每个人都活在盛世里想干嘛就干嘛......
此时的叶恒也注意到了艾米的不安，他轻轻握住了艾米的手，给予她鼓励和安慰：“艾米姐，别担心，每个人都有自己的专长和了解，你并非历史学者，但你的勇气和决心同样重要。
我们是一个团队，需要互相理解和支持，相互关心。”
说着，他伸出手，轻轻拍了拍艾米的肩膀，仿佛在传递着一种无形的力量，艾米抬起头，眼中闪烁着感激的光芒，轻轻点了点头，重新振作起来。

叶恒：“那好，向龙心塔前进”
众人尾随叶恒的步伐，毅然踏上了朝向龙心塔的征途，阳光斑驳地穿透树冠的缝隙，如同细碎的金粉，轻轻洒落在他们的肩头与背脊，为这段旅程镀上了一层温暖而光明的色彩，脚下的土壤既坚实又带着白日余温，仿佛每一寸都蕴藏着引领他们前行的无言希望。
他们穿梭在郁郁葱葱的森林深处，每一步都踏过岁月的痕迹，越过那些见证了无数风雨的山丘，崎岖不平的路途并未减缓他们的步伐，反而让彼此间的欢声笑语更加响亮，回荡在林间，成为这段旅程中最动听的旋律，在这不经意间，一种难以言喻的默契与深厚的信任在他们心中悄然生根发芽，连接着每一个人的心房。
终于，龙心塔巍峨的身影映入眼帘，与此同时，夜幕也悄然降临，为这片古老的土地披上了一层神秘的面纱。
远观之时，龙心塔巍然耸立，直插云霄，仿佛是大自然与人类智慧共同雕琢的奇迹，又似是连接此界与彼岸的神秘门户，引人遐想无限。
而此刻，当叶恒真正踏上通往塔前的石阶，那份从远距离观赏所无法触及的震撼，如同潮水般汹涌而至，深刻而强烈，让在场的每一个人都感受到了前所未有的心灵触动。
塔内昏暗而神秘，宛如被历史的尘埃轻轻覆盖的古老秘境，仅有几缕微弱的灯光如细丝般穿透黑暗，顽强地照亮着前方蜿蜒曲折的道路，这些灯光在斑驳的石壁上跳跃，投下斑驳陆离的光影，为这座古塔平添了几分不可言喻的幽邃，顺着年久失修的木质楼梯一步步向上走去，每一步都伴随着古老石阶的低吟，仿佛能听见岁月在耳边轻声细语。
每到达一个转角，眼前豁然开朗，不同的景色和雕刻如画卷般徐徐展开，黑龙与白龙在天穹之上盘旋翱翔，它们的鳞片在想象中闪耀着冷冽或炽热的光泽，翅膀拍打间带起的风声呼啸而过，似乎连空气都在为之震颤，而在不远处的湖中，金龙与红龙正嬉戏耍闹，湖水被它们庞大的身躯搅动得波光粼粼，金色的光辉与绚烂的红霞交织在一起，美得令人窒息，这些雕刻栩栩如生，每一笔每一划都蕴含着匠人的心血与灵魂，它们静静地诉说着一段段古老而神秘的故事，让人不由自主地沉醉其中。
龙国篇龙国篇第十九章龙心塔（二）
当叶恒终于踏上塔顶的那一刻，眼前的景象如同神迹般降临，瞬间将他从沉思中惊醒，一座巨大无匹的水晶球赫然悬浮于半空之中，它散发着耀眼而纯净的光芒，将整个塔顶照耀得如同白昼，那光芒不带丝毫杂质，温暖而柔和，却又蕴含着无尽的力量与威严，仿佛能够洞察世间万物，水晶球内部，各种奇妙的景象流转不息，星辰运转、云雾缭绕、奇花异草竞相绽放，还有那若隐若现的生灵穿梭其间，一切都显得那么不真实，却又如此震撼人心。

Dragon Kingdom Chapter Dragon Heart Chapter 19 Dragon Heart Tower (2)
"It worked, it finally worked!"
Ye Heng stood up suddenly, his eyes flashing with excitement. He stared at the map in Amy's hand, and his fingertips quickly sketched out routes on it. "I locked the source of the dragon's energy. It spurted out from a specific point like a thin thread, and that point, where the dragon's energy gathered so densely, was undoubtedly the Dragon Heart Tower."
Ye Heng: "Our current terrain is really a headache. We are obviously in the center of the city, and it seems that we are only a short distance away from the Dragon Heart Tower. But in fact, due to the steepness of the terrain and the interference of the dragon energy, every time we try to move forward, we seem to be pulled by some invisible force and return to the starting point. It is as if we have stepped into a mysterious formation from the very beginning when we entered Shenlong City."
Having said this, Ye Heng took a deep breath and slowly raised his right hand. On the palm of his hand, a bright light quietly emerged. It was his unique light-attribute martial power. "But don't be discouraged. My light-attribute martial power will be the key for us to break through this maze. It will guide us to find the right path and lead us to the Dragon Heart Tower."
Ai Lu couldn't help but tilted her mouth, with a suspicious look on her face: "Is this... reliable?"
Seeing this, Amy glared at Elu, with a hint of dissatisfaction in her tone: "Can you stop talking nonsense? What time has it been now, and you are still so suspicious? Although Ah Heng is a B-level Martial God, his judgment and ability are incomparable to traitors like you?"
"Okay, okay, Sister Amy, just calm down, calm down, don't argue with her."
He said while stopping Elu.
The laughter and flirtation between the two was like a warm and slightly playful picture, which quietly touched Ye Heng's heartstrings and made him fall into deep thoughts involuntarily.
"How wonderful it would be if there was no war in the world."
However, the edges of reality are as sharp as a knife, and the haze of war is like an invisible giant net, quietly covering this land. It is silent, but extremely sharp, deeply cutting everyone's heart, leaving scars that are difficult to heal.
Ye Heng's eyes dimmed, and endless emotion surged in his heart.
He knew that in these turbulent years, every moment of peace and laughter was so precious, like a clear spring in the desert, longing for but hard to reach.
This beauty seems to be close at hand, yet out of reach, like a dreamy bubble that will shatter at the touch of a touch.
He silently stared at everything in front of him, with mixed feelings in his heart. The cruelty of war made him cherish the moment of tranquility in front of him even more. Even if it was as fragile as a candle in the wind and could be extinguished at any time, it was this preciousness and difficulty that made Ye Heng strengthen his inner belief. In order to protect this rare tranquility, he was willing to make every effort to pursue that distant and beautiful peaceful world. He believed that Xin believes that as long as people have love and a desire for peace in their hearts, one day, war will go away and peace will come. He is looking forward to that day, looking forward to seeing the three sisters playing carefree again in the future, just like 12 years ago, looking forward to the whole world being fine. This is not only the dream of Ye Heng, but also the dream of all the Martial Gods and everyone.
Clothes are plentiful and food is abundant; the country is prosperous and the people are peaceful; the lights are dimming and the family is happy, allowing everyone to live in a prosperous age and do whatever they want...
At this time, Ye Heng also noticed Amy's uneasiness. He gently held Amy's hand and gave her encouragement and comfort: "Sister Amy, don't worry, everyone has their own expertise and understanding. You are not a history scholar, but your courage and determination are equally important.
We are a team and need to understand and support each other and care for each other. "
As he spoke, he stretched out his hand and patted it gentlyPatting Amy on the shoulder, as if conveying an invisible force, Amy raised her head, her eyes shining with gratitude, nodded slightly, and cheered up again.
Ye Heng: "Okay, let's move towards the Dragon Heart Tower"
The crowd followed Ye Heng's steps and resolutely embarked on the journey towards the Dragon Heart Tower. The sunlight penetrated the gaps in the canopy like fine gold powder, gently falling on their shoulders and backs, coating the journey with a layer of warm and bright colors. The soil under their feet was both solid and full of daytime warmth, as if every inch contained a silent hope to lead them forward.
They shuttled through the depths of the lush forest, each step passing through the traces of time, and crossing the hills that had witnessed countless wind and rain. The rugged road did not slow down their pace, but made each other's laughter louder, echoing in the forest, becoming the most beautiful melody on this journey. Inadvertently, an indescribable tacit understanding and deep trust quietly took root in their hearts, connecting everyone's heart.
Finally, the majestic figure of the Dragon Heart Tower came into view. At the same time, night fell quietly, casting a mysterious veil over this ancient land.
When viewed from a distance, the Dragon Heart Tower stands majestically, reaching into the sky. It seems to be a miracle sculpted by nature and human wisdom, and it also seems to be a mysterious portal connecting this world and the other side, attracting people's endless imagination.
At this moment, when Ye Heng actually stepped onto the stone steps leading to the tower, the shock that could not be touched from a distance surged like a tide, deep and strong, making everyone present feel an unprecedented touch to their hearts.
The inside of the tower is dim and mysterious, like an ancient secret realm lightly covered by the dust of history. Only a few faint lights penetrate the darkness like filaments, tenaciously illuminating the winding road ahead. These lights dance on the mottled stone walls, casting shadows on them. The mottled light and shadow below add a bit of indescribable depth to this ancient tower. Walking up the wooden stairs that have been in disrepair step by step, each step is accompanied by the whisper of the ancient stone steps, as if you can hear the years whispering in your ears.
Every time you turn a corner, your eyes suddenly open up. Different scenery and sculptures slowly unfold like scrolls. Black dragons and white dragons are hovering and soaring in the sky. Their scales shine with cold or hot luster in imagination. The sound of wind brought by the flapping of their wings roars past, and even the air seems to be trembling. And in the lake not far away, golden dragons and red dragons The dragons are playing and playing, the lake water is stirred by their huge bodies, the golden light and the gorgeous red clouds are intertwined, it is breathtakingly beautiful. These carvings are lifelike, and every stroke contains the hard work and soul of the craftsman. They quietly tell ancient and mysterious stories, making people involuntarily intoxicated.
Dragon Kingdom Chapter Dragon Heart Chapter 19 Dragon Heart Tower (2)
When Ye Heng finally stepped onto the top of the tower, the sight in front of him came like a miracle, instantly waking him up from his meditation. A huge crystal ball was suspended in the air. It exuded dazzling and pure light, illuminating the entire top of the tower like day. The light did not contain any impurities, and was warm and soft. It is harmonious, but it also contains endless power and majesty, as if it can see everything in the world. Inside the crystal ball, various wonderful scenes are constantly flowing, stars are rotating, clouds and mist are lingering, exotic flowers and plants are blooming, and looming creatures are passing through it. Everything seems so unreal, but so shocking.
